g.title: RoofMotion
g.text: one step per worker poll · west opens first, east closes first
green = a relay is energized · grey = both relays off
a half already at its target is skipped from OPEN_KICK or CLOSE_RODCLEAR, before anything is energized

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE
g.text: relays off, rod running its stroke

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE->OPEN_RUN
g.text: and the closed switches are clear

g.title: OPEN_SETTLE->FAULT
g.text: or the half is still closed

g.title: ANY
g.text: · a Roof consistency check latched (any status read)
